psychological_meaning: Baltic Sea evokes feelings of calm, mystery, and sophistication. It represents introspection and a connection to the natural world, particularly the depths of the ocean. This color can also suggest stability, resilience, and a subtle elegance, often associated with things that are timeless and enduring.
